parameters.query:
SELECT text, metadata, 1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector) AS score
FROM documents
ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::vector
LIMIT $2;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.model, prompt: $json.prompt, stream: false, think: false, options: { num_ctx: 8192, temperature: 0.3 } }) }}
